gaps: First-contact crash: check_pr_ticket dies with a raw git fatal on the PR that INTRODUCES plans/roadmap.json (roadmap_at has no missing-path fallback) - the most likely pilot failure.
Branch-shape mismatch: branch inference knows only feat/{key}- while the KnackLabs constitution mandates Git Flow feature/* - every compliant client branch would fail inference.
Double-run: the harness repo has a 3-epic roadmap, so an epics-only arming rule would run the vendored gate on top of the internal pr-ticket-check/board-invariant.
Branch hardcoding: copying the existing vendored-workflow pattern (push: branches [main]) would make the push job silently never fire on a develop-default client.
Severity ambiguity: the spec says the push job fails on 'coverage gaps' but forge project audit is a superset (pending-story fields, missing outcomes, vendor drift).
resolutions: Root-cause fix at the git-show call site: base ref without the file resolves to {} (the shared git() raiser is untouched); pinned by a base-absent-roadmap test.
branch_ticket accepts a prefix tuple (feat/, feature/); pinned by a feature/KEY-branch test.
Arming is VENDORED_FROM presence AND epics>=1 - the same discriminator factory-scaffold.yml already uses; the harness (no VENDORED_FROM) never arms; pinned by the workflow-shape test.
The new workflow uses bare push: with a job guard on github.event.repository.default_branch; the pre-existing hardcoding in factory-scaffold/harness-health is deferred with a trigger, not replicated.
Human chose FULL audit severity at plan grill (AskUserQuestion 2026-08-10): the myclaw pilot's incomplete stories red its main by design - the red list is the to-do list.
notes: Interrogated against FORGE-ALIGN-3 acceptance criteria, the strict-alignment spec, and the 31 active decisions. Human approved in plan mode (0029). New decision 0036 client-gates-arm-on-roadmap created post-approval per the plan.
